coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

behavior.input_fields: capacity field at 0(rdi), base pointer at 8(rdi), length field at 0x10(rdi)
behavior.gate: slow arm taken exactly when requested (rdx) > remaining, unsigned
behavior.fast_path: memcpy(base + length, entry rsi, requested); length += requested; return 0 with rdx restored to requested
behavior.slow_arm: call 0x1564e60 with (object, old length, requested, rcx = 1, r8d = 1); reload length; jump back to the fast path without re-checking capacity
behavior.padding: fifteen int3 bytes follow the window before the next FDE start

claim: one append window: memcpy past the current length when capacity allows, otherwise an unnamed grow call and a retry
